Players Committee card image of [[I Don't Like Sand (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top two cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a card here into hand to prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny). (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/idontlikesand_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d7f8f0471e0da467f7416b6b60cb834ea8a0b87c d7f8f04] (21 February 2025). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
